facts.fact: La Nouvelle Republique reports the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications launched the insat.mpt.gov.dz portal for citizens' complaints, suggestions and audience requests on postal and telecom services; no case numbers are given.

The Mediator of the Republic's office created the digital platform Tansik, presented in Tipaza on 22 April 2024, to digitise citizens' grievance registers across local and central administrations and track their handling; no case count is given.
Algeria's Ministry of Youth launched the Sawtoukoum platform, announced 20 April 2026, where users submit concerns and report shortcomings and track each submission to resolution.
The Médiateur de la République's electronic grievance-register portal had received 52,262 grievances nationwide since October 2023, according to its digitisation director.
